The 2026-11-16 tables are archived unchanged as `charging_snapshots_as_supplied_2026-11-16.csv`. Changes were made only where the primary document disagreed with the table.

| Item | As supplied | Now | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Maharashtra, Feb-2024 | 3,728 | **3,079** | PIB 6 Feb 2024, Annexure II (checked twice; Maharashtra 3,079; all-India 12,146) |
| First snapshot | "End of 2022", approximate (MH ~600, DL ~500, TN ~400, WB ~100); all-India 5,151 | **Mar-2023**, official (MH 660, DL 1,845, TN 441, WB 189; all-India 6,586) | PIB 24 Mar 2023, Annexure A. Delhi ~500 conflicts with 1,845 three months later and with 1,886 in Feb-2024 |
| Aug-2026 snapshot label | "Rajya Sabha, Aug 2026" | **Confirmed by the team**: Rajya Sabha Unstarred Q.2333, Ministry of Heavy Industries, answered 7 Aug 2026 | The all-India total 52,718 was first cited in a Lok Sabha written reply of 21 Jul 2026 (IANS); the state annexure was tabled in the Rajya Sabha on 7 Aug 2026 |
| Delhi and West Bengal Aug-2026 | ~3,800 and ~1,200* | unchanged, flagged as estimates | The asterisk marks an estimate, not a verbatim readout: published summaries of the annexure gave exact counts only for top states. Replace with the annexure values when checked |

Impact: charging values change for Jan-2022..Feb-2023 (now back-filled from Mar-2023 and flagged), and Feb-2024 Maharashtra; the Dec-2025 and Aug-2026 values are unchanged. Every stage was re-run.
